A1.justification: Both complete 28-page PDFs describe the same Speculative Verdict work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–N support reliable comparison; renamed and relocated displays can be matched.

before.justification: v2 reports original SV benchmark evaluations, ablations, cost measurements and recovery/failure analyses in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results, including benchmark evaluations in Tables 1–2 and component and failure analyses in the appendices.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same consensus expert selection, normalized peer-NLL scoring, draft reasoning paths and single-call verdict synthesis. The method's components, inputs and inference procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate InfographicVQA, ChartMuseum, ChartQAPro, HR-Bench 4K, TallyQA-Complex and MathVista-testmini. No dataset, task or distinct test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding main-text and appendix comparisons retain the same baselines, including DeepEyes, Pixel-Reasoner, majority voting and LLaVA-Critic variants. Changes from GPT-o1 to o1 and MiMO to MiMo correct names without changing comparator membership.

E3.justification: Model configurations, sampling, metrics, PP-StructureV3 preprocessing and prompting protocols are retained. Appendix C.1's pricing-date correction agrees with November 2025 already stated in v2's Table 8 caption; it does not establish a changed costing procedure.

E4.justification: Section 4.5 and the appendices retain the same expert-count, selection, model-pool, normalization, NLL and verdict-input ablations. Recovery, expert-complementarity, failure analyses and qualitative examples are also unchanged after matching renumbered displays.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports experimental seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars or statistical significance tests.

E6.justification: Section 4.2(iv) corrects the reported ChartQAPro margin over DeepEyes from 11.3 to 15.3 percentage points. Both versions' Table 1 already reports 64.0 for SV with GPT-4o and 48.7 for DeepEyes, supporting 15.3. Other matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: The NLL, relative-consensus and global-consensus definitions in Section 3.4 are unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem or proof is added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about training-free reasoning synthesis, error correction, generalization and cost efficiency. The corrected comparison margin does not redefine these core claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of complementary drafts, consensus selection and verdict synthesis remain unchanged. Appendices H–K retain the same qualifications concerning structured input, fine-grained extraction, color matching, verbosity bias and tool-driven failures.

D1.justification: Appendix C.1 corrects the pricing reference date from September to November 2025, and v4 adds an acknowledgement of NYU IT HPC support. The reproducibility statement now refers to released code instead of anonymized supplementary code, although both abstracts already provide the same repository link; newly available code is therefore not established.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B and the bibliography retain the same cited works and research positioning. Reference reflow and corrected model names do not change the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v4 replaces the preprint header with an ICLR publication header, adds equal-advising attribution and acknowledgements, and makes limited edits to model names, cross-references and reproducibility/LLM-use statements. The scientific narrative and section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: The recovery chart incorrectly captioned Table 11 in v2 becomes Figure 9 in v4, with subsequent display numbers and references updated. Table 4 clarifies the SV row label, and some appendix text and tables shift position. No substantive visual content is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v4 improves accuracy and navigability by correcting the DeepEyes comparison margin, fixing the recovery chart's caption and references, and resolving inconsistent pricing-date documentation. These are useful but limited corrections; the method, empirical evidence and substantive conclusions remain unchanged.
